blockers.description: Yjs/CRDT collaboration is installed but completely unwired — no real-time co-editing, no conflict resolution, no operational transform. The collaboration feature listed in the app's marketing is currently non-functional beyond basic presence.
5 marketplace store unit tests are failing (state shape mismatch in MarketplaceStore). This blocks CI green status for the marketplace feature.
Physics engine (@react-three/cannon) is installed but completely unused. Dead dependency adding ~200KB to bundle with zero functionality.
No OBJ/FBX import support — only GLB/GLTF. Many 3D workflows require FBX or OBJ interop, limiting usability for professional users.
Animation system is basic — no easing curves, no skeletal animation editing, no glTF animation export. Timeline exists but limited for production animation workflows.
No E2E testing (Playwright/Cypress). Only unit tests exist. Critical user flows (login → create project → edit scene → save → export) are not tested end-to-end.
No email verification or password reset flow. Users can register but cannot recover accounts.
Orthographic camera editing mode is not available in the main 3D viewport — only used in background decorative scenes. Professional 3D apps require top/front/side orthographic views.
No API documentation (Swagger/OpenAPI). Backend has 40+ endpoints without formal documentation beyond the READMEs.

verdict: OBJEKTA is a 75% complete 3D web design application with a strong engine, comprehensive scene editor, excellent materials/post-processing, and a full marketplace — its primary gaps are real-time collaboration (Yjs unwired), limited animation, and missing orthographic editing views.
